Cost definition (v5 matched budgets, as F-DTwoCost): whole fields in priority order (fixed-seed random order inside ties); a field is routed while observed spend plus its development-estimated expected cost (per model and action, mean realised calls and mean-token estimates on v5 development) fits the budget; observed spend charges realised calls (one reflection call, plus two either-order verifier calls when the action proposes a change; a widen action that reuses the NT answer is charged the NT calls, which v5.py does not charge) and mean-token estimates (test token logs); stops at the first field that does not fit; no fractional fields. token cost definition of the v5 matched comparisons
facts.value: Tokens per field are mean-token estimates, not exact per-call totals: each realised call is charged the mean prompt plus completion tokens of its stage (reflection or verifier) for that dataset and model in the test token logs (results/naacl/v6/v5/tokens), falling back to the model's mean; expected token costs for selection use the same means from the development logs.
